北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天晴但体感 3℃，风干物燥，记得多补水保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like 3℃, dry and windy. Stay hydrated and warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 11℃ 略凉，微风不燥，适合出门走走！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 11℃, with a gentle breeze. Perfect for a walk!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，体感 10℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖与健康。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze, feels like 10℃. Wear a mask, stay warm and healthy.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 25℃，体感舒适。轻装出行，享受美好！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 25℃, feels comfortable. Dress lightly and enjoy!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温 26℃，体感温暖。记得多喝水，防晒哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 26℃, feels warm. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，气温 14℃，体感舒适。很适合户外活动！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels like 14℃. Perfect for outdoor activities!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天晴但体感 8℃。早晚温差大，注意及时添衣哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels like 8℃. Mind the temperature change, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 11℃ 左右。注意保暖，出门记得带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels around 11℃. Stay warm and bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 11℃。出门记得戴口罩，呵护呼吸道健康。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 11℃. Wear a mask for respiratory health.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天晴但体感 7℃，湿度 7%。超级干燥，多喝水润燥防感冒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels like 7℃, very dry. Stay hydrated and prevent colds!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 12℃ 左右。早晚凉，出门记得添衣哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels around 12℃. Dress warmly in mornings and evenings!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴但体感低至 -7℃！穿好最厚实的衣物，注意防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -7℃! Bundle up, stay extremely warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -3℃ 并有风。出门注意防风保暖，别着凉！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -3℃ with wind. Stay warm, avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明天晴，气温 19℃，但风力 4级体感凉。小心别被风吹感冒了！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, 19℃, but feels cool with 4-level winds. Be careful not to catch a cold!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 12℃ 并有风。风力 3级，出门添衣防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 12℃ with 3-level winds. Dress warmly for the breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛天晴，体感 5℃。虽有阳光，但温度不高，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels like 5℃. Despite the sun, stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连天晴但体感 -1℃。温度较低，出门一定穿暖和些哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels like -1℃. It's cold, so dress warmly!
